haberler.baslik_tr: Lavrov'dan Ukrayna ve müzakere açıklamaları
haberler.baslik_en: Lavrov makes statements on Ukraine and negotiations
haberler.baslik_orj: ❕ Key takeaways from statements by Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov: ▪️ Russia is holding substantive talks with the United States on …
haberler.ozet_tr: Rusya Dışişleri Bakanı Sergey Lavrov, ABD ile Ukrayna ve çatışmanın çözümü konusunda sahadaki gerçekler ile kök nedenler dikkate alınarak anlamlı görüşmeler yapıldığını belirtti. Avrupalıların Ukrayna'daki çözüm görüşmelerinde hangi rolü oynayabileceklerini anlamadıklarını ifade eden Lavrov, Rusya'nın müzakere pozisyonunu özel askerî operasyon için belirlenen hedeflere ulaşılacak şekilde şekillendireceğini kaydetti. Avrupa Komisyonu Başkanı Ursula von der Leyen'in Ukrayna müzakerelerinden önce ateşkes çağrısının bir sonuç vermeyeceğini söyleyen Lavrov, Avrupalıların zamanın daraldığını fark ederek sürece dahil olmak istediğini dile getirdi.
haberler.ozet_en: Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov stated that meaningful discussions are being held with the US regarding Ukraine and the resolution of the conflict, taking into account realities on the ground and root causes. Stating that Europeans do not understand what role they can play in settlement talks in Ukraine, Lavrov noted that Russia will shape its negotiating position in a way that achieves the goals set for the special military operation. Saying that European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen's call for a ceasefire before Ukraine negotiations would yield no results, Lavrov voiced that Europeans want to get involved in the process upon realizing that time is running out.

İki ülkenin henüz bu aşamaya gelmediğini ifade eden Baghaei, konunun detaylarının görüşülmediğini vurguladı.
haberler.ozet_en: Iranian Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Esmail Baghaei stated that no negotiations are being conducted between Iran and the United States regarding the suspension or reduction of uranium enrichment activities. Stating that the two countries have not yet reached that stage, Baghaei emphasized that the details of the issue have not been discussed.

Israel Hayom gazetesinin İsrailli ve ABD'li kaynaklara dayandırdığı habere göre, bu istihbarat üzerine ABD makamları harekete geçti.
haberler.ozet_en: The Israeli intelligence agency Mossad shared information with the CIA regarding an alleged Iranian plot to assassinate US President Donald Trump and senior administration officials using drones. According to a report by the Israel Hayom newspaper citing Israeli and US sources, US authorities have taken action following this intelligence.

haberler.ozet_tr: Rusya Federal Güvenlik Servisi (FSB), Stavropol kentinde bir alışveriş merkezine bombalı saldırı düzenlemeyi planlayan bir kişiyi gözaltına aldı. FSB basın servisi, şüphelinin Orta Asya vatandaşı olduğunu ve uluslararası bir terör örgütüyle bağlantılı olduğunu açıkladı. Yakalanan şahsın saldırı hazırlığında olduğu belirtildi. Olayla ilgili soruşturma devam ediyor.
haberler.ozet_en: The Russian Federal Security Service (FSB) detained an individual who was planning to carry out a bomb attack on a shopping mall in the city of Stavropol. The FSB press service announced that the suspect is a Central Asian national and has links to an international terrorist organization. It was stated that the suspect was in the preparation phase for the attack, and the investigation into the incident is ongoing.

According to information on the company's website, services such as Claude, Claude Code, and Cowork are also unavailable in Venezuela, Iran, North Korea, Syria, and Cuba.

Ghalibaf emphasized that no one should interfere in Yemen's internal affairs and Yemenis should resolve their disputes among themselves.

Rızai, Amerika'nın hata yapması halinde yakın üslerin yanı sıra uzak bölgelerdeki üslere de saldırabileceklerini belirtti.
haberler.ozet_en: Secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council Mohsen Rezaei stated that if aircraft take off to attack Iranian territory, they will not hesitate to target distant bases as well, including US military bases in European countries. Rezaei noted that if America makes a mistake, they can strike bases in distant regions alongside nearby ones.

haberler.ozet_en: According to Politico's sources, NATO is considering reducing its foreign missions in regions such as Iraq and Kosovo following the withdrawal of US troops from Europe. It is stated that the alliance wants to focus its efforts on countering Russia.

haberler.ozet_en: Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf announced that Iran and Oman have reached an agreement regarding the shipping corridor and traffic separation scheme in the Strait of Hormuz. Ghalibaf stated that a return to the pre-war situation will not happen and that this is among Tehran's conditions.
